name: docich-monorepo-root
description: Fail-safe only: the Cloudflare Workers Builds project root must be workers/tsuitate-bot (see workers/tsuitate-bot/BUILDS.md). If a build ever runs at the repository root, this delegates to the Worker directory so the same build runs with the same working directory instead of failing with ENOENT on a missing root package.json (#1571). It defines no dependencies and installs nothing.
